image_description: A man wearing a red jacket and blue cap is holding a large sturgeon fish horizontally. The background appears to be the white siding of a building or boat. The fish is gray with visible bony plates (scutes) along its side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly elongated and the mouth is positioned on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct barbel structures are visible hanging down in front of the mouth area.
The snout tapers to a distinct point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is long, cylindrical, and tapers at both ends, fitting the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are clearly visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal area. No typical fish scales are present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a pale white/cream color on the belly.
The caudal fin is visibly asymmetrical, with the upper lobe extending further than the lower lobe, characteristic of a heterocercal tail.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike primitive fish.
To verify the integrity of the scutes and ensure they are physically attached to the body without melting or floating artifacts.
To check for general AI generation artifacts like skin texture smoothing on the human subject or lighting inconsistencies.
To detect the human subject and provide bounding boxes for context, ensuring the fish is being held correctly relative to the hands.

focus_areas: Scute texture and attachment to skin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the scutes; AI often blurs these into the skin or makes them look like painted patterns rather than 3D objects. Verify the barbel count is exactly four. Check the man's hands for any fusion with the fish's slippery skin.
